title: Turing’s Mill: AI Supercomputer Revs UK’s Economic Engine
description: The home of the first industrial revolution just made a massive investment in the next one. The U.K. government has announced it will spend £225 million ($273 million) to build one of the world’s fastest AI supercomputers. Called Isambard-AI, it’s the latest in a series of systems named after a legendary 19th century British engineer […]

title: Unlocking the Power of Language: NVIDIA’s Annamalai Chockalingam on the Rise of LLMs
description: Generative AI and large language models are stirring change across industries — but according to NVIDIA Senior Product Manager of Developer Marketing Annamalai Chockalingam, “we’re still in the early innings.” In the latest episode of NVIDIA’s AI Podcast, host Noah Kravitz spoke with Chockalingam about LLMs: what they are, their current state and their future […]
